title: Mitchell and Delbridge survey of the speech of Australian adolescents
citation: Mitchell, A. G. and Delbridge, Arthur. The Speech of Australian Adolescents: A Survey. 1965.

governance.retention_or_deletion_duties: Do not acquire, retain, upload or process source data while the recorded rights state blocks use.

population.description: 7,736 students recorded at 330 schools across every Australian state and territory in 1959 and 1960, each reading two fixed consonant rich sentences.
limitations: The non commercial licence excludes it from this project entirely, under the same rule that already excluded TIMIT and L2-ARCTIC.
The recordings are from 1959 and 1960, so they describe the Australian English of that period rather than current speech.
This is the largest Australian speech resource this project cannot use, and it is recorded as a loss rather than an omission.

annotation.provenance: No annotations acquired; public collection records were read.
limitations: No source record may enter engineering while access or rights remain blocked.

inspected_materials: Public collection records for the digitised survey, read 2026-07-29.
findings: The collection is anonymously downloadable, so its exclusion rests on the licence rather than on access.

The University of Sydney repository record refuses automated requests, so the non commercial licence recorded by the 2026-07-28 search was not independently re verified here. A non commercial licence and an unverified licence both fail closed, so the verdict does not depend on which is true.
